name: Strata
description: Runs the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model on a 12 GB+ consumer GPU and serves it locally over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, for people connecting chat apps and coding agents.

skills.name: OpenAI-Compatible API
skills.description: Serves chat completions with streaming and tool calls at http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1.

skills.name: Anthropic Messages API
skills.description: Accepts Anthropic Messages requests so Claude Code can point ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the local server.

skills.name: Responses API
skills.description: Serves the OpenAI Responses API statelessly for Codex CLI and similar clients.

skills.name: Image Input
skills.description: Reads attached pictures in chat or through the API when image support is enabled at setup.

skills.name: Management MCP Server
skills.description: Lets an AI assistant install, start, stop, and check Strata through a bundled MCP server.
